name: remove
declaration: unsafe fn remove (& mut self , entry : & mut UnsafeListEntry < T >)
documentation:
Removes an entry from the list.

 # Safety

 The caller must ensure that `entry` has been pushed onto `self`
 prior to this call and has not moved since then.
rules: The caller must ensure that `entry` has been pushed onto `self` prior to calling `remove`.
The caller must ensure that `entry` has not moved since it was pushed onto `self`.
